description: Patch instant rule conditions/config with version/hash guards and before/after seeded tests. System rules require applyGlobally:true and admin permission. Write action; requires confirmation.

applyGlobally.description: Required true for system rules. Updates every customer copy of the system rule.

block.description: Block the source IP when the instant conditions match. Has no effect while the rule is in test mode.

blockConditions.description: Optional stricter conditions that must also match before blocking (same shape as conditions).

blockMatchMode.description: Match mode for blockConditions: all or any (default any).

blockTtlHours.description: How long an instant block lasts, in hours (default 6, max 168).

conditions.description: Optional full replacement instant conditions array. Use operations for smaller patches.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

dryRun.description: When true, validates and runs before/after seeded tests without saving.

executionMode.description: Rule execution mode: instant or hybrid when instant detection is enabled.

expectedCurrentInstantHash.description: Required SHA-256 hash of the current instant config from securenow_alert_rule_get.

expectedCurrentRuleHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the current instant/throttle/severity surface from securenow_alert_rule_get.

fixtures.description: Optional seeded fixtures. Each may include kind attack/benign, label, path, method, requestBody, requestHeaders, and expectMatch.

matchMode.description: Condition match mode: all or any.

operations.description: Condition patch operations: add_condition, remove_condition, update_condition. Use zero-based index/conditionIndex for remove/update.

reactivatePausedCopies.description: Whether to reactivate paused noisy copies after the instant rule is tuned.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

reviewNote.description: Optional review note. Defaults to reason.

reviewNotificationId.description: Optional notification id tied to this review/tuning action.

severity.description: Optional severity override: critical, high, medium, or low.

throttle.description: Throttle patch, for example { enabled:true, minutes:15 }.

name: securenow_alert_rule_instant_update
title: Update Instant Alert Rule
